text:
alex c: Morning triage — quick snapshot:
- Open tickets: 42 (3 high, 12 medium, rest low)
- Known issues: embeddings latency spike, intermittent SMTP failures for digests
- Macros to update: ack-embeds, escalation-acme

alex c: Blockers: embeddings queue backlog impacting ACME batch export, need an ETA on KV-cache rollback or mitigation.

samir: I can look into embeddings runtime. Seeing a lot of 503s from embedder pod after the midnight scaler. Suspect bad quantized kernel causing retries.

samir: Pinging eng-oncall for immediate check and to consider rolling back the last embedder kernel patch.

eng-oncall: On it. Starting investigation — collecting logs now. If rollback needed, will coordinate with eng-runtime.

lina: SMTP failures: ticket-bot shows 5 failed sends in last hour, retries ongoing. Might be GoldenGate queue lag.

tanya: I'll update macros and send an interim customer message for ACME. Drafting macro now.

tanya: Macro draft (will apply):
```
/macro edit ack-embeds "Thanks for the report — we're seeing an embeddings processing delay for some large batch jobs. We're investigating and will follow up within 2 hours."
```

tanya: Also creating a temporary macro 'escalate-acme' to include priority contact info.

ticket-bot: New ticket assigned: #4852 (ACME) — added 'needs-eng-escalation' tag.

alex c: Priorities this morning:
1) Get embeddings backlog under 100 items (samir + eng-oncall)
2) Apply macro and send customer update (tanya)
3) Monitor SMTP retries and reduce failed sends (lina)

samir: Quick ask — can someone unpin the NPU autoscale change from last night? I think that's the trigger.

eng-oncall: Confirmed the autoscale config flip at 00:12 correlates with errors. Rolling it back now.

tanya: I'll post the customer message after rollback confirmation. :thumbsup:

alex c: Thanks team — please drop any quick status updates here. If you need to escalate to SRE/eng-platform, mention @eng-sre.

lina: SMTP retry success rate improving, down to 1 failure in last 15m. Keeping watch.

samir: Rollback completed by eng-oncall — embedder 503s dropping. Starting a controlled requeue of 300 stuck jobs.

tanya: Message sent to ACME using 'ack-embeds'. Ticket #4852 updated.

alex c: Update for report: open tickets 40, high 2. Will do an end-of-shift pass at 6pm. :white_check_mark:
